text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright believes the light of the Mejiros can outshine even the most dazzling Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober, as well, hopes to shine that light on today's stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the strong desires of the other Umamusume electrifying the air, it seems we're in for a close contest today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, Mejiro Bright surges forward without hesitation toward the Arima Kinen to claim it for the Mejiros.
